steps.text: Combat tokens shuffled into two facedown piles
Quest tiles shuffled faceup; 3 on the explorer track spaces
2 players: cover Maracaibo with the Maracaibo city tile
City tiles for your player count: the two marked ones plus 2 random; shuffle and place on Puerto Plata, Santo Domingo, Port Royal and Cartagena
Shuffle A and B project cards separately; deal 8 A-cards each; shuffle 40 B-cards with the remaining A-cards as the deck; reveal 4
Doubloons, synergy tokens and victory point tokens as a supply
4 prestige buildings along the top: 1 faceup on I, 3 facedown on II-IV; box the rest unseen
Ownership markers beside the influence track: 1 on the leftmost space, 2 on the others
2 players: a red ownership marker on San Juan, white on St. Kitts, blue on Martinique
No campaign: put story card 75 on its space and follow it
steps.note: Campaign: follow the Campaign setup on p.3 instead

steps.text: Ship board with 2 discs on each marked circle (24 discs)
VP marker on 0, ship on Havana, explorer on the explorer start, an influence marker on 0 of each nation
Markers: combat track 1, doubloon income 8, victory point income 0
2 figures, 2 career cards and an overview card
Start player is whoever was last on a ship; doubloons in turn order: 8, 9, 10, 11
From your 8 project cards keep 4, put 1 on a planning space and discard 3
Keep 1 career card and put 3 figures from the supply on it
The start player moves their ship first; play is clockwise
